user.title: Jinan Utilities
user.description: Choose the service and login method. For gas (Shandong Towngas), **WeChat authorization is recommended**: no SMS needed, authorize once in WeChat and the balance refreshes every 30 minutes. For water (Jinan Water), **Phone only** is recommended: only the registered mobile number is needed. Mobile + SMS code also works. Password login is unavailable because the portal image-captcha service is broken.

manual.title: Paste PC portal link / manual token (legacy gas)
manual.description:
A bare gas account number cannot return any data (the gateway requires an access_token before it even reads the account number).

Gas (legacy, not recommended): open the 'Shandong Towngas' WeChat official account > Online Hall > tap the top-right menu > Copy Link, then paste the FULL link below. If it contains tokenCode or code, the integration exchanges it for an access_token automatically. You can also paste {"access_token":"...","refresh_token":"..."} from localStorage, or a bare access_token.

Gas (desktop): sign in at https://wt.shandongtowngas.com.cn/ , DevTools Network, copy token from any /openapi/uv1/ request.

Water: prefer Phone only, this step is normally unnecessary.

{error}
